character: A large multi-peak resort in central Vermont off US Route 4, generally regarded as the largest ski area in the eastern US, and known for aiming at a long season with early openings.
learning: Reference note: the Snowshed slope and the Ramshead base are the usual beginner and family areas. Confirm current learning lifts and lesson programs.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Nov 11, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Killington publishes its historical opening and closing dates (see More links), but they were not captured in this research, so no estimated window is derived.

prices.note: OnTheSnow listing described as the "most recent" adult weekday price; the season was not stated. Killington prices are date-specific and cheaper when bought early. Confirm at source.

openQuestions: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30 (OnTheSnow projects Nov 11, 2026).
Confirm 2026-27 Ikon Pass / Ikon Base terms (lead from earlier seasons: days shared with Pico) and Killington's own pass products.
Confirm 2026-27 adult day-ticket prices: OnTheSnow lists $205 adult (18-64) weekday with no season stated; prices are date-specific.
Confirm published lift, ticket-office, rental and lesson hours for 2026-27.
Confirm the current owner/operator (POWDR sold Killington and Pico to a local ownership group in 2024 — reference).
Capture actual 2024-25 and 2025-26 opening and closing dates from the official historical open/close page (More links) so an estimated window can be derived.
Confirm official deep links on killington.com (snow report, lift status, trail map, lessons, webcams, parking) and the snow-report format.
Resolve the lift count (20 vs 22; the 22-lift breakdown sums to 21) and confirm skiable acres (1,526 in the summary), trail difficulty split, snowmaking %, childcare and tubing.
Transit leads to confirm: Amtrak's Ethan Allen Express serves Rutland; a local bus has served Killington Road. Rutland (RUT) is the closest airport.

research.confidenceNotes: Partly researched on 2026-09-30 (search summaries only; page fetches blocked). Terrain (1,526 acres, 155 trails, 20–22 lifts by source) and a $205 weekday adult price of unstated season are search-summary facts. Identity, coordinates, elevations, owner, homepage and the few features set remain Piste reference data (unverified). The OnTheSnow opening date is a projection. Drive and airport times are Piste estimates. Pass access was not re-researched.
